changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla survey_responses: encuesta final (Likert) y SUS de una inscripción. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría survey_responses_audit y el trigger survey_responses_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Final survey (Likert) and SUS answers of an enrollment

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE survey_responses ADD CONSTRAINT survey_responses_type_ck CHECK (survey_type IN ('final'))
ALTER TABLE survey_responses ADD CONSTRAINT survey_responses_sus_items_ck CHECK (sus_items IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof(sus_items) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(sus_items) = 10))
ALTER TABLE survey_responses ADD CONSTRAINT survey_responses_sus_score_ck CHECK (sus_score IS NULL OR sus_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
CREATE TRIGGER survey_responses_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON survey_responses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in survey_responses

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE survey_responses_audit ADD CONSTRAINT survey_responses_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER survey_responses_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON survey_responses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS survey_responses_audit_trg ON survey_responses
